title: The small intestine finishes digestion and absorbs nearly all the nutrients
summary: OpenStax says the small intestine is where digestion is finished and where nearly all absorption of nutrients happens.
body: OpenStax says the small intestine is where digestion is completed and virtually all absorption occurs. Circular folds, villi, and microvilli enlarge the inner surface. Segmentation shifts the contents back and forth so mixing has more chances. The three regions the chapter names are the duodenum, the jejunum, and the ileum. This card is that finishing-and-absorbing job. It does not list foods.
